docs.text: Blog and resources Edit an article Go to Posts → All Posts and select an article, or choose Add New . Maintain the title, body, categories, excerpt and featured image, then preview and save. The theme renders the article header and content through its single-post template. A Blog Inline CTA block is available for a call to action inside an article, with a headline, CTA label, CTA URL and background image. Listings and categories The posts page is selected under Settings → Reading → Posts page . The theme supplies the blog hero and listing layout. Category archives use the same layout family, filtered to the category. Manage categories through Posts → Categories and assign them in each post’s settings. The Resources page template also renders the blog layout. Listing cards draw from WordPress posts; they are not individual cards edited in the page body. Related articles on post pages are selected by the theme using categories. Developer follow-up: confirm the assigned posts page, category labels, featured-post behavior and any remaining sample content against the current database.

docs.text: Forms The Homepage Hero and Contact Lead blocks integrate with Gravity Forms . Each has a Gravity Form ID field. The homepage hero also exposes an optional form-shortcode field; ask the developer to confirm its use before replacing an existing setup. Basic maintenance Open Forms in WordPress and identify the form used by the page. Edit its fields in Gravity Forms. Review confirmations and notifications in the form settings. Keep the page block’s Gravity Form ID matched to the intended form. Save and test the form on the front end, including required-field errors and the confirmation message. Form headings in the page block are separate from form input labels. If the form does not render, have the developer verify plugin activation and the selected form ID. Developer follow-up: document the actual form names/IDs, notification recipients, delivery setup, integrations and spam protection after checking the current configuration. Do not add credentials or submission data to this guide.

docs.text: Homepage Open the homepage Check Settings → Reading to identify the page assigned as the homepage, then open it under Pages . The theme supports editable ACF homepage blocks. It also has a fallback layout rendered from theme defaults when homepage block content is absent. If the editor is empty but the front end shows sections, ask the developer to populate the editable blocks before making content changes. Available homepage sections Section Main content fields Homepage Hero Label above headline, headline, subcopy, background, form title/subtitle, Gravity Form ID, service cards Stats Bar Metrics Services Grid Headline and cards Operations Features Headline, copy and features Mission Tabs Headline and tabs Finley CTA Headline, copy, button label/URL, background and Finley image Industries Carousel Headline, copy and cards Nexus Platform Label, headline, lead, body, image and checklist Video Spotlight Label, headline, copy, video file/URL and poster image Select the existing block in List View and edit its fields. Keep the established section order unless a layout change is intended. Some empty fields display theme defaults, so clearing a value may not remove it from the page. The hero’s form title and subtitle belong to the block; form inputs and submission settings belong to Gravity Forms .

docs.text: Header, footer and menus Header Open Appearance → Customize → Header . Available settings include: Logo and sticky header. Header CTA label and URL. Header email link. Phone display text and phone link. Update the visible phone number and its tel: link together. The email link uses a mailto: address. Footer Open Appearance → Customize → Footer to edit the about/blurb text, primary and secondary CTA labels/URLs, support email, sales email and copyright line. The theme also uses shared logo and phone settings. Preview the result and use Publish to save Customizer changes. Navigation Open Appearance → Menus , choose the menu and edit its links. Drag child items beneath their parent to create dropdown items, then save. The theme registers these menu locations: Location Purpose Primary Menu Header navigation Footer — Knowledge Base Footer knowledge links Footer — Payment Solutions Footer solution links Footer — Legal Footer legal links Footer Menu (legacy) Compatibility location; confirm usage before assigning Check location assignments under Manage Locations . Header/footer buttons are controlled in the Customizer, separately from menu links.

docs.text: Editing pages Go to Pages → All Pages and open the page. Open List View to locate the existing section. Select the block and edit its ACF fields; switch to the block’s editing mode if it is showing a preview. For lists such as cards, logos or steps, edit the existing repeater rows. Preview after adding, removing or reordering rows. Preview links, images and spacing, then save the page. Templates Inner Page adds a hero above the page content. It uses the page title, excerpt and featured image, with an Inner Page Hero field group for the label, headline override, button and background. The Customizer’s Inner Pages section supplies a fallback hero background and compact hero height. Resources renders the theme’s blog hero and post listing. Its layout is composed by the theme; editing the page body does not control that listing. Avoid changing an existing page’s template without checking the preview. Solution page sections The theme includes Solution Hero, Logos Strip, Process Steps, Video Copy Split, Trust Image Cards, Platform Tags Split, Feature Duo and Finley CTA blocks. These are the section family documented for Banking & Treasury in the theme source. Actual page placement should be confirmed in the editor. Other available sections include Team Grid (headline, intro and members) and Contact Lead (copy, bullets, form heading and Gravity Form ID). Images and links Choose images through the Media Library and provide useful alternative text for meaningful images. Check button labels and destinations together. Preserve existing headline formatting when editing fields labeled “HTML allowed”; it may control the highlighted words.
